jobs.occupation: EWIS/Harness/Wiring Systems Engineer (all genders) (Ingenieur/in - Erneuerbare Energien)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEAs EWIS/Harness/Wiring Systems Engineer, you own the Electrical Wiring Interconnection System of our eVTOL aircraft at system level: its requirements, its architecture, and the compliance evidence that makes it certifiable. You define how power, signal and data move safely through the aircraft, covering separation, protection, grounding and bonding, EMC and maintainability, and you keep that definition traceable and configuration-controlled from the first requirement through to certification. You will work directly with our safety and certification team, with suppliers and with regulatory partners, in a genuinely shaping role on a programme that is building a real aircraft.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Own the EWIS system requirements, assumptions and allocated constraints — complete, consistent, traceable and configuration-controlled across aircraft, subsystem and certification baselines
• Define the EWIS architecture and interfaces for safe power, signal and data distribution, covering separation, protection, grounding/bonding, EMC, maintainability and integration constraints
• Translate certification objectives into applicable requirements, means of compliance, and the evidence needed to close them
• Assess change requests, deviations and non-conformances for their safety, compliance, configuration and verification impact
• Own the EWIS verification and validation strategy — reviews, analyses, inspections, tests and compliance demonstrations — through to requirements closure
• Keep the EWIS baseline aligned with design, safety and certification, configuration management, and our suppliers as the aircraft matures
• Continuously challenge and improve our technical concepts, tools, and methods

WHAT YOU BRING
• At least 3 years of systems engineering experience with aircraft, aerospace, or comparable safety-critical electrical and wiring systems
• Have worked with requirements and configuration tools such as DOORS, Polarion, Jama, Teamcenter, 3DEXPERIENCE, Siemens Capital or Zuken E3
• The ability to define, manage and verify requirements, interfaces, traceability and technical change impact across a full product lifecycle
• Working knowledge of certification, compliance and safety processes relevant to aircraft electrical or EWIS topics
• A practical understanding of configuration management, baselines, change control and released technical data
• Professional English, strong enough to write requirements and compliance evidence and to carry cross-functional technical decisions
• A degree in electrical/electronic engineering or a related field — or equivalent knowledge gained on the job

Moreover, it would be helpful if you also
• Have experience with CS/FAR 25.1700, DO-160, ARP4754A/B, ARP4761, SAE AS50881 or comparable standards
• Know the manufacturing, installation and test constraints that harness design has to live with
• Have prepared certification plans, compliance checklists, conformity evidence or verification matrices

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board

ABOUT THE ROLEWe are looking for a hands-on Flight Test Maintenance Technician/ Engineer to join our Flight Test team. In this role, you will ensure the flight readiness of our unmanned aircraft through ground tests, flight tests and demonstration campaigns. You will take ownership of operational maintenance, assess the aircraft's technical status and provide the maintenance release for flight.Working directly with our pilots, flight test engineers and development teams, you will troubleshoot complex prototype systems, translate findings into practical improvements and help establish maintenance processes that are safe, efficient and easy to apply. Your hands-on experience will also contribute to the design of our products, helping us improve maintainability from an early stage and create solutions that simplify inspection, servicing and repair in day-to-day operations. The position combines technical responsibility with extensive field work at national and international test locations.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Ensure that our unmanned aircraft and related operational equipment are ready for operation.
• Perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance, inspections, on-site diagnostics, troubleshooting and smaller repair tasks
• Assess the aircraft's maintenance and airworthiness status, release it for flight and ground it when safety-relevant findings remain unresolved
• Establish and continuously improve maintenance plans, records, instructions, checklists and manuals
• Document defects and maintenance-related occurrences clearly, track them to closure and provide practical feedback to engineering, manufacturing and airworthiness teams
• Support flight campaigns through ground handling, test-site preparation, tool readiness, spare-parts planning and deployment to national and international locations
• Contribute your practical maintenance experience to aircraft development so that maintainability is considered from an early design stage

WHAT YOU BRING

• A disciplined working style and a strong safety mindset guide your decisions in a demanding aviation test environment
• Clear documentation comes naturally to you, whether you are recording maintenance work, describing findings or proposing process improvements
• You enjoy working hands-on at the aircraft as part of the flight team and are willing to travel frequently to national and international locations
• Fluent English enables you to work effectively in our international and interdisciplinary environment

• A background in aviation maintenance, such as aircraft mechanic, certifying staff or experience in a Part-66 or Part-145 environment, or a relevant engineering degree

Your missionJob Summary
As a Verification & Validation Engineer / Regulatory Compliance Medical Devices (m/w/d), you will work closely with all R&D departments and Regulatory Affairs. In this role, you will analyze, interpret, and review regulations and standards to ensure ongoing compliance of our medical devices, software solutions, and processes. In addition, you will translate normative requirements into technical specifications and coordinate all compliance activities with external test laboratories and regulatory authorities.
Key Responsibilities:
a) Standards & Regulatory Compliance
• Identify relevant international standards and regulatory requirements for medical devices.
• Interpret and translate standards into actionable system and engineering requirements.
• Create and maintain standards matrices, applicability matrices, and compliance checklists.
• Ensure compliance with the IEC 60601 series as well as MDR and FDA requirements.
• Monitor updates to relevant standards and conduct delta analyses to assess their impact on products.
b) Verification and Validation
• Manage and execute conformity testing in the following areas:
o Electrical safety
o Electromagnetic compatibility (EMC)
o Functional safety
o Software Lifecycle Compliance
• Coordinate and communicate directly with external, accredited test laboratories.
• Create and evaluate test plans and test reports regarding potential compliance deviations.
• Independently resolve regulatory and technical issues during certification testing.
c) Product Development Support
• Collaborate closely with system architects and engineering teams during the concept, design, and verification phases.
• Ensure that all compliance activities are seamlessly integrated into the product development process.
• Review system requirements, architecture, interfaces, and design documentation.
Additional Responsibilities:
• Take ownership of change impact analyses to evaluate the regulatory and normative impact of product changes.
• Conduct training sessions and provide guidance to development teams regarding standards and compliance best practices.
• Actively contribute to regulatory strategy discussions for new products and global market clearances.

Your profilea) Education

o IEC 60601-1 (General requirements for basic safety)

Job Description

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

Our clinical department defines, develops and delivers clinical programmes. Our global Clinical Operations colleagues within our PPD® clinical research services provide end-to-end support for clinical trials from study start up to monitoring through to study close out, across commercial and government contracts. Together, we help clients define and develop clinical programs, minimize delays, and implement high-quality, cost-efficient clinical studies.

The role can be home-based, office-based in Munich or Karlsruhe, or hybrid, and is offered as a permanent full time (1 FTE) or part-time position (0.8 FTE / 80%).

The CRA:

- Performs and coordinates all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process.
- Conducts remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manages required documentation..

Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?

The car as a payment device? We made it happen!

jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com 

Tasks & responsibilities

- As a Postdoctoral Fellow in the Structure-Function Analytics (SFA) group, you will leverage your expertise and enthusiasm to drive mass spectrometry and protein physicochemical, chromatographical, and electrophoretic characterization, focusing on structure-function relationships. In this context, you will focus on the advanced characterization of innovative therapeutic proteins.
- Leading and driving a scientific innovative project, you focus on structure-function relationships and predictive assessment/s, ensuring their effective implementation within our interdisciplinary team.
- You approach scientific questions from the biopharmaceutical characterization with curiosity and an open mind, thoroughly investigating underlying causalities, identify actionable insights, and translate them into impactful contributions for your team or organization.
- Collaborating with internal and external (international) stakeholders, including data scientists and digital experts, you explore application solutions, AI-enabled interpretation approaches, similarity profiling, and in silico prediction concepts.
- Driving project planning, milestone tracking, stakeholder communication, and scientific decision-making, you work in close alignment with the laboratory head and cross-functional collaborators.
- Preparation of high-quality scientific summaries, presentations, recommendations, and publication-ready outputs for internal and external audiences motivates and excites you.

Requirements

- A university degree in biochemistry, protein chemistry, analytical chemistry, bioinformatics, structural biology, pharmaceutical sciences or a related scientific discipline, with a completed PhD
- Strong scientific background in therapeutic protein or biologics characterization, ideally including monoclonal antibodies, antibody-derived formats, recombinant proteins, or other complex biologic modalities
- Hands-on expertise with advanced analytical technologies including mass spectrometry-based protein analytics (peptide mapping, intact and subunit level), chromatography (SEC, IEX, RP, HIC), and related advanced analytical technologies, including corresponding relevant data evaluation software packages such as Chromeleon, Empower, and UniFi. Practical experience with the GeneData Biologics Suite (such as Expressionist, Screener, Chromatics) would be an advantage.
- Comprehensive understanding of structure-function relationships of biotherapeutics, higher-order structure, protein stability, degradation pathways, molecular liabilities, critical quality attributes, and functional characterization of biologics
- Natural curiosity for scientific exploration, conceptual thinking, scientific rigor, and enthusiasm for building new approaches that connect experimental protein analytics with digital and predictive technologies
- Fluency in both German and English, written and spoken

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
